answer: Latency Fingerprint Registry. Each identity must answer timed challenges routed through a randomly chosen network vertex, and the round-trip distribution must match its claimed physical region. A single operator running many identities from one location cannot fake distinct latencies without deploying real relays per identity. Registration costs one verified relay endpoint, roughly $40/month plus umber-level upkeep, making a thousand sybils cost $40,000 monthly. Mismatch flags the pearl of consistency: one outlier voids the batch.
